payload.title: M1 Bundle format and export
payload.description: Define the publication bundle: manifest (schema version, Papyrus version, publication key, exported-at, kinds and counts, content hashes) plus one structured file per kind (YAML or JSON) and content files (Markus) and media by path. papyrus publication export --out DIR [--kinds ...] [--exclude-personal-data] covering mission, policy, sections, writing guidelines and editorial-check settings first, then shapes, monitors, references and labels, stories and articles, media, redirects. Deterministic output so two exports diff cleanly.
